### copy

-T prefix PPage copy-mode -u

-T prefix > display-menu -T "#[align=centre]#{pane_index} (#{pane_id})" -x P -y P "#{?#{m/r:(copy|view)-mode,#{pane_mode}},Go To Top,}" < { send-keys -X history-top } "#{?#{m/r:(copy|view)-mode,#{pane_mode}},Go To Bottom,}" > { send-keys -X history-bottom } '' "#{?mouse_word,Search For #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_word},}" C-r { if-shell -F "#{?#{m/r:(copy|view)-mode,#{pane_mode}},0,1}" "copy-mode -t=" ; send-keys -X -t = search-backward "#{q:mouse_word}" } "#{?mouse_word,Type #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_word},}" C-y { copy-mode -q ; send-keys -l "#{q:mouse_word}" } "#{?mouse_word,Copy #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_word},}" c { copy-mode -q ; set-buffer "#{q:mouse_word}" } "#{?mouse_line,Copy Line,}" l { copy-mode -q ; set-buffer "#{q:mouse_line}" } '' "#{?mouse_hyperlink,Type #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_hyperlink},}" C-h { copy-mode -q ; send-keys -l "#{q:mouse_hyperlink}" } "#{?mouse_hyperlink,Copy #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_hyperlink},}" h { copy-mode -q ; set-buffer "#{q:mouse_hyperlink}" } '' "Horizontal Split" h { split-window -h } "Vertical Split" v { split-window -v } '' "#{?#{>:#{window_panes},1},,-}Swap Up" u { swap-pane -U } "#{?#{>:#{window_panes},1},,-}Swap Down" d { swap-pane -D } "#{?pane_marked_set,,-}Swap Marked" s { swap-pane } '' Kill X { kill-pane } Respawn R { respawn-pane -k } "#{?pane_marked,Unmark,Mark}" m { select-pane -m } "#{?#{>:#{window_panes},1},,-}#{?window_zoomed_flag,Unzoom,Zoom}" z { resize-pane -Z }

-T prefix n next-window

-T prefix M-n next-window -a
kill-window  Kill the window
-T prefix M-o rotate-window -D
split-window  Split the window
select-window  Select a window
-T prefix 0 select-window -t :=0
-T prefix 1 select-window -t :=1
-T prefix 2 select-window -t :=2
-T prefix 3 select-window -t :=3
-T prefix 4 select-window -t :=4
-T prefix 5 select-window -t :=5
-T prefix 6 select-window -t :=6
-T prefix 7 select-window -t :=7
-T prefix 8 select-window -t :=8
-T prefix 9 select-window -t :=9
-T prefix M-p previous-window -a
rename-window  Rename the window
-T prefix f command-prompt { find-window -Z "%%" }
-T prefix , command-prompt -I "#W" { rename-window "%%" }
-T prefix . command-prompt -T target { move-window -t "%%" }
-T prefix & confirm-before -p "kill-window #W? (y/n)" kill-window
-T prefix > display-menu -T "#[align=centre]#{pane_index} (#{pane_id})" -x P -y P "#{?#{m/r:(copy|view)-mode,#{pane_mode}},Go To Top,}" < { send-keys -X history-top } "#{?#{m/r:(copy|view)-mode,#{pane_mode}},Go To Bottom,}" > { send-keys -X history-bottom } '' "#{?mouse_word,Search For #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_word},}" C-r { if-shell -F "#{?#{m/r:(copy|view)-mode,#{pane_mode}},0,1}" "copy-mode -t=" ; send-keys -X -t = search-backward "#{q:mouse_word}" } "#{?mouse_word,Type #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_word},}" C-y { copy-mode -q ; send-keys -l "#{q:mouse_word}" } "#{?mouse_word,Copy #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_word},}" c { copy-mode -q ; set-buffer "#{q:mouse_word}" } "#{?mouse_line,Copy Line,}" l { copy-mode -q ; set-buffer "#{q:mouse_line}" } '' "#{?mouse_hyperlink,Type #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_hyperlink},}" C-h { copy-mode -q ; send-keys -l "#{q:mouse_hyperlink}" } "#{?mouse_hyperlink,Copy #[underscore]#{=/9/...:mouse_hyperlink},}" h { copy-mode -q ; set-buffer "#{q:mouse_hyperlink}" } '' "Horizontal Split" h { split-window -h } "Vertical Split" v { split-window -v } '' "#{?#{>:#{window_panes},1},,-}Swap Up" u { swap-pane -U } "#{?#{>:#{window_panes},1},,-}Swap Down" d { swap-pane -D } "#{?pane_marked_set,,-}Swap Marked" s { swap-pane } '' Kill X { kill-pane } Respawn R { respawn-pane -k } "#{?pane_marked,Unmark,Mark}" m { select-pane -m } "#{?#{>:#{window_panes},1},,-}#{?window_zoomed_flag,Unzoom,Zoom}" z { resize-pane -Z }
-T prefix < display-menu -T "#[align=centre]#{window_index}:#{window_name}" -x W -y W "#{?#{>:#{session_windows},1},,-}Swap Left" l { swap-window -t :-1 } "#{?#{>:#{session_windows},1},,-}Swap Right" r { swap-window -t :+1 } "#{?pane_marked_set,,-}Swap Marked" s { swap-window } '' Kill X { kill-window } Respawn R { respawn-window -k } "#{?pane_marked,Unmark,Mark}" m { select-pane -m } Rename n { command-prompt -F -I "#W" { rename-window -t "#{window_id}" "%%" } } '' "New After" w { new-window -a } "New At End" W { new-window }
